window_turn: About two minutes, keyboard and clicks as a student would. It opened on 'New lesson / What do you want to work on?' with 'Sampling distributions' preselected and a Return key next to it. Return put me straight into a task with the caret in the answer box. Clicking 'Hint' printed 'You asked for a hint.' plus the hint, but below the answer box. A wrong answer ('b = 5') got a quiet ✕ in the gutter and 'Not right yet, with a hint': no red, no score, which didn't sting. Esc, then 'by the way, is this even on the midterm?' got an unmarked reply, and the open task stayed visible above. Tab took me back into the task. I answered '2'. The tutor wrote 'Right', but no mark appeared and the record didn't add one, so the screen stayed truthful even though that confused me for a second. Esc, then 'ugh I am behind, can you change the plan' opened the plan in a right pane with the old date struck through and the new date and moved block marked with gold bars. The moved block was at the very bottom edge, under a table of facts I didn't need. ⌘K, typing 'record', then Return opened the Record in a tab: one line, '14:11 standard error of a mean, Not right yet, with a hint', and 'Not yet answered right alone; asked again Fri 13 Nov.' Neutral, not a scoreboard. The perf op measured median 17 ms, p95 19 ms, startup 756 ms. I released the lock afterwards.
